pages.text: Storm Alloy: first conversion step from storm fragments into the midgame material line.
Core Stabilizer: baseline part for pressure resistance builds.
Crystal Matrix: shared core for beacon, charm and endgame recipes.
Sanctum Key: required to start the Sanctum Gate elite event.
Annihilation Blade: endgame melee finisher. See $(l:nutonmod:items/annihilation_blade)detail page$().
Thunder Spear: core weapon in the Arbiter progression line. See $(l:nutonmod:items/thunder_spear)detail page$().
Void Calamity: charge-based ranged burst bow. See $(l:nutonmod:items/void_calamity)detail page$().
Storm Scepter: energy-based area control caster. See $(l:nutonmod:items/storm_scepter)detail page$().
Note: this page focuses on progression-critical combat recipes first; auxiliary utility recipes may be expanded later.
